strings: r_c is getting a little tired of treating m_c's painful, loose and clicky joints, but {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/realise/realises} that theres a reason m_c is in {PRONOUN/r_c/poss} den so often.
m_c is always tired and always in pain, and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/decide/decides} it's time to speak to a medicine cat.
m_c has always been a trickster, showing off {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} stretchy skin and bendy joints, but they soon feel the pain that comes from it and realises why {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} body feels this way.

m_c has to go to the dirtplace very frequently, and getting there always hurts {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} joints. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} thought this was normal, but after speaking to some other cats, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} realise its not.
After speaking to some of their Clanmates, m_c discovers that not every cat is in pain all the time.
